data.name: Unavailable
data.value: Worker unavailable: no elevation, IPC or mutation handlers are implemented.

data.name: Code_operation_recovery_required
data.value: An earlier operation needs recovery first. Restart Winora or run recover so it can be reconciled.

data.name: Code_operation_not_reversible
data.value: This operation cannot be reverted.

data.name: Code_operation_superseded
data.value: A newer operation has changed this value, so this older operation can no longer be reverted. Nothing was changed.

data.name: Code_operation_revision_unknown
data.value: The journal has no record of the exact state this operation produced, so it cannot be reverted safely.

data.name: Code_operation_resource_changed
data.value: The value changed while the action was starting. Nothing was changed; review the current value and try again.

data.name: Code_operation_external_conflict
data.value: The simulated value was changed by something else, so Winora did not overwrite it. Review the current value.

data.name: Code_operation_verification_failed
data.value: The value was written but could not be verified. Review is required.

data.name: Code_operation_reconciled_partial
data.value: After an interruption the value matched neither the original nor the requested value. Review is required.

data.name: Code_operation_rollback_uncertain
data.value: The revert could not be confirmed. Review is required.

data.name: Code_operation_rollback_failed
data.value: The revert did not restore the previous value. Review is required.

data.name: Code_operation_cancelled
data.value: The action was cancelled before it changed anything.

data.name: Code_plan_stale
data.value: The simulated value changed after you reviewed it. Nothing was applied; review the change again.

data.name: Code_plan_duplicate_feature
data.value: The plan lists the same feature more than once.

data.name: Code_plan_missing_dependency
data.value: The plan depends on a feature that is not part of it.

data.name: Code_plan_resource_conflict
data.value: Two features in the plan change the same resource.

data.name: Code_plan_dependency_cycle
data.value: The plan has features that depend on each other in a cycle.

data.name: Code_journal_revision_conflict
data.value: The record was changed by another action. Refresh and try again.

data.name: Code_journal_operation_missing
data.value: The operation record could not be found.

data.name: Code_journal_invalid_transition
data.value: That change of state is not allowed for this operation.

data.name: Code_journal_invalid
data.value: Winora's local journal could not be read safely, so it stopped to protect your data. No Windows setting was changed.

data.name: Code_journal_schema_unsupported
data.value: The local journal was created by a newer version of Winora and was not opened.

data.name: Code_journal_schema_corrupt
data.value: The local journal structure is damaged and was not opened.

data.name: Code_journal_migration_conflict
data.value: The local journal could not be upgraded safely and was not changed.

data.name: Code_journal_untrusted_definition
data.value: A journal entry did not match any known definition and was ignored.

data.name: Code_store_busy
data.value: Winora's local storage is busy. Nothing was changed; try again in a moment.

data.name: Code_store_unavailable
data.value: Winora's local storage could not be reached. Nothing was changed; check disk access and try again.

data.name: Code_store_failure
data.value: Winora's local storage reported an error. Review storage before retrying.

data.name: Code_protocol_size
data.value: The request was too large and was rejected.

data.name: Code_protocol_version
data.value: The request uses an unsupported protocol version and was rejected.

data.name: Code_protocol_operation
data.value: The request has no valid operation identifier and was rejected.

data.name: Code_protocol_command
data.value: The request command is not supported and was rejected.

data.name: Code_protocol_feature
data.value: The request names a feature that is not supported and was rejected.

data.name: Code_worker_unimplemented
data.value: This action is not available yet. Nothing was changed.

data.name: Code_profile_size
data.value: The profile file is too large and was not imported.

data.name: Code_profile_invalid
data.value: The profile is not valid and was not imported.

data.name: Code_profile_duplicate_property
data.value: The profile repeats a setting name and was not imported.

data.name: Code_access_denied
data.value: Access was denied. Nothing was changed.

data.name: Code_error_unexpected
data.value: Something unexpected happened. Nothing was reported as successful. You can copy the reference when asking for help.

data.name: Code_discovery_unavailable
data.value: This information is not available on this computer.

data.name: Code_discovery_item_unreadable
data.value: Some entries could not be read and were skipped.

data.name: Code_setting_unknown
data.value: This setting is not part of Winora's catalog. Nothing was changed.

data.name: Code_setting_choice_invalid
data.value: That choice is not valid for this setting. Nothing was changed.

data.name: Code_setting_unsupported_build
data.value: This setting is not supported on this version of Windows. Nothing was changed.

data.name: Code_setting_state_unrecognized
data.value: This setting currently holds a value of a kind Winora does not manage, so Winora will not change it. Nothing was changed.

data.name: Code_shell_refresh_failed
data.value: The setting was changed, but Windows could not be told to refresh, so some apps may not show it yet. You can apply it again from History.

data.name: Code_shell_restart_failed
data.value: The setting was changed, but Windows Explorer could not be restarted, so it takes effect after you sign out or restart Explorer. You can try again from History.

data.name: Code_target_not_allowed
data.value: Winora refused a change outside its own catalog. Nothing was changed.

data.name: Code_target_kind_unsupported
data.value: The administrator helper does not support this kind of setting. Nothing was changed.

data.name: Code_diagnostics_destination_invalid
data.value: The chosen folder cannot be used for the diagnostics archive. Pick a normal local folder outside Winora's own data folder. Nothing was created.

data.name: Code_diagnostics_export_failed
data.value: The diagnostics archive could not be created. Nothing was uploaded and no partial file was kept; check disk space and folder access, then try again.

data.name: Code_elevation_unavailable
data.value: Administrator changes are not available in this session or installation.

data.name: Code_elevation_unsigned_build
data.value: This build is not signed by the expected publisher, so administrator changes are turned off.

data.name: Code_elevation_install_untrusted
data.value: Winora's installation location or files cannot be trusted for administrator changes.

data.name: Code_elevation_uac_disabled
data.value: User Account Control is turned off, so administrator changes are not available.

data.name: Code_elevation_client_elevated
data.value: Run Winora without administrator rights to make machine changes.

data.name: Code_elevation_declined
data.value: The administrator prompt was declined. Nothing changed.

data.name: Code_elevation_launch_failed
data.value: The administrator helper could not be started. Nothing changed.

data.name: Code_elevation_blocked
data.value: Windows or your organization blocked the administrator helper. Nothing changed.

data.name: Code_elevation_timeout
data.value: The administrator helper did not respond in time. Nothing changed; trying again shows the prompt again.

data.name: Code_elevation_server_untrusted
data.value: The administrator helper could not be verified, so nothing was sent to it.

data.name: Code_elevation_client_untrusted
data.value: The helper refused the requesting program because it could not be verified.

data.name: Code_elevation_channel_failed
data.value: The secure channel to the administrator helper failed. Review the change before trying again.

data.name: Code_elevation_confirmation_required
data.value: Administrator changes need an interactive confirmation. Run this in an interactive window.

data.name: Code_elevation_platform_unsupported
data.value: Administrator changes are not supported on this version of Windows.

data.name: Code_elevation_platform_unverified
data.value: Administrator changes have not been verified on this Windows configuration, so they are turned off.

data.name: Code_definition_unknown
data.value: The change is not in Winora's trusted list.

data.name: Code_definition_set_mismatch
data.value: The app and the helper disagree about the trusted list.

data.name: Code_definition_revoked
data.value: The change was withdrawn and is no longer available.

data.name: Code_definition_signature_invalid
data.value: Winora's trusted list failed verification.

data.name: Code_definition_rollback
data.value: An older trusted list was refused.

data.name: Code_trust_store_insecure
data.value: The machine trust record has unsafe permissions.

data.name: Code_setting_managed_by_policy
data.value: This setting is managed by a policy. Winora does not change it.

data.name: Code_worker_busy
data.value: Another administrator helper is running. Try again in a moment.

data.name: Code_worker_hardening_failed
data.value: The administrator helper could not start safely on this system. Nothing changed.
